full_page.content:
1955, July 25
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Blessed be God in all His designs!
July 25º 1955 -- Fifty-two years deacon To-day. Dec Gr. God bless you Grace and Doris!
Many thanks for your wire congratulations, etc., etc. Thanks be to God Grace is at least well enough to come home. Now Grace; you must at least for a month or so, take things easy, and as much as possible avoid worry. If you were to take a six months vacation it would be the proper thing to do.
(No Signature)
Note: Above probably to Grace and Doris Panyard of Muskegon, Michigan
